author: freeCodeCamp.org
description:
Learn how to use Trae IDE to plan, build, and deploy a full-stack habit tracker. You will learn how to leverage modern AI-assisted development tools—including multi-agent collaboration, intelligent code completion, and automated scaffolding—while working with React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. By the end of the course, you will have transformed a simple idea into a fully working, production-ready application deployed live on the web.

Try TRAE: https://www.trae.ai/?utm_source=influencerglobal&utm_medium=meeco&utm_campaign=freecodecamp

Course created by @aniakubow 

⭐️ Contents ⭐️
- 00:00 Introduction
- 01:57 How to get started with TRAE IDE
- 07:19 How to PLAN your app with AI as your collaborator
- 11:40 How to BUILD your app with AI as your collaborator
- 15:49 How to run multi-agents
- 20:39 How to ship your app
